scope: Private v9 server request-budget clamp and reused-slot isolation; does not establish behavior of the current v10 production server.
rule: Use one freshly launched private single-slot server, four distinct prompts, cache_prompt=false, greedy 16 tokens. Capture exact requests, native raw responses, echoed caps and actual draft_n presence/count for every request. Effective settings expected 0,7,8,8 in order; omit request cap in last request to test reuse reset. No field absence is converted to an invented zero; if the server cannot witness zero drafted steps the zero-draft clause remains unknown. Any failed, interrupted or missing request remains unknown and is never redrawn as though unexposed. A bounded tiny-model v9 result does not assert production v10 behavior.
